added.added: The company is added. The mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
added.invited: The company is added and the invitation to the owner is sent. The mandate becomes active once they confirm it.
added.hasOwner: The company already has an owner in Fakturist — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
added.existing: The company is already in Fakturist without an owner. Your mandate waits for confirmation by Fakturist; the owner is invited by the firm that added it.

invite.ok: The invitation to the owner is sent.
invite.firmMember: This is an email of the firm’s employee — the invitation is for the company’s owner.
invite.rateLimited: The firm’s daily invitation limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
invite.hasOwner: The company already has an owner — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
invite.notFound: There is no active or pending mandate for this company.
invite.invalid: The invitation could not be sent.
invite.notCreator: The owner is invited by the firm that added the company to Fakturist. Your mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
invite.invited: Fakturist or another firm has already invited the owner — wait for their answer.
invite.locked: This company’s ownership was revoked in a dispute — only Fakturist invites a new owner.

org.limit: The free plan includes {limit} documents a month. Above that documents are still issued — consider a paid plan.
org.via: Access through an accounting firm's authorisation

doc.title: New document
doc.rateHelp: Only for a currency other than euro — for VAT in euro (Art. 114(5) of the VAT Act).
doc.linesHelp: Empty lines are skipped. Decimals with a dot or a comma. Start typing a name — your items are suggested.
doc.issueHelp: The number is assigned on issue. An issued document cannot be edited — corrections are made with a note.
doc.problems: The document was not issued — please fix:
doc.buyerEmailHint: Optional: for recurring invoice emails and payment reminders.
doc.noItems: Save the goods and services you sell often once in
doc.pdfLanguageHint: The XML has no language. The document is always in Bulgarian; English goes alongside it (Accountancy Act, Art. 5).

view.viaFirm: On behalf of the company, under the authorisation of
view.chain: Link no. {index} in the chain · fingerprint

client.title: New client company
client.help: The firm issues on behalf of the company under a written authorisation (Art. 113(7) of the VAT Act). The authorisation takes effect once the company's owner (if it has an account) or Fakturist confirms it after checking the document.
client.ownerEmailHelp: Optional. The owner gets an invitation and takes over ownership; with one tick they also confirm your mandate. Until then it waits.

errors.firmMember: This is an email of the firm’s employee — the invitation is for the company’s owner.
errors.rateLimited: The firm’s daily invitation limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.hasOwner: The company already has an owner — the mandate waits for their confirmation.
errors.notFound: There is no active or pending mandate for this company.
errors.invalid: The invitation could not be sent.
errors.notCreator: The owner is invited by the firm that added the company to Fakturist. Your mandate waits for confirmation by the owner or by Fakturist.
errors.invited: Fakturist or another firm has already invited the owner — wait for their answer.
errors.locked: This company’s ownership was revoked in a dispute — only Fakturist invites a new owner.

client.processorDeclaration: I declare that the client company has authorised the firm in writing to use Fakturist for its documents and that the firm has taken on the obligations of a processor under Art. 28(3) GDPR in its contract with the client.

security.title: Security
security.mustChange: Change your temporary password before you continue.
security.setup: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) or type the key in, then confirm with the six-digit code.
security.required: Two-factor sign-in is mandatory for the master account.

ok.password: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.help: Documents that companies registered with Fakturist issue to you (by EIK). They arrive automatically and an email with the PDF and XML goes to the owners, administrators and accountants.
inbox.verified: The sender is a company verified by Fakturist.
inbox.unverifiedHelp: The sender has not been verified by Fakturist yet — check the details and the account before you pay.
inbox.acceptHelp: The document is for us and the details are correct.

mandates.title: Authorisations
mandates.help: The accounting firms that issue on behalf of the company (Art. 113(7) of the VAT Act). A firm cannot issue until you confirm its authorisation.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.pdfIntro: The logo, font and layout of the PDF copy you send to your clients. The structured XML (UBL and CII) does not change.
settings.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 10 MB — a phone photo works too. It is reduced to at most 1200×600 pixels without metadata (location); SVG is not accepted.

classic.name: Classic
classic.help: White header, the number in the accent colour — closest to a paper invoice.

band.name: Band
band.help: A coloured band with the document type and number; the logo sits in a white box inside it.

compact.name: Compact
compact.help: Smaller type and narrower margins — more lines per page.

settings.fontHelp: Every font has Cyrillic, € and Bulgarian quotation marks.
settings.accentHelp: For the number, the band and the rule above “Amount due”. A colour that is too light is rejected — it must read on white (contrast at least 4.5:1).
settings.contentNote: The look changes appearance only. The VAT Act particulars, the amounts, the mandate and the Fakturist signature are in every look.

saved.pdf: The look is saved. It also applies to already issued documents the next time they are downloaded.

errors.invalidAccent: The colour is in the #rrggbb form.
errors.lowContrast: The colour is too light — choose a darker one.
errors.logoType: The logo is PNG, JPEG or WebP.
errors.logoCorrupt: The file cannot be read as an image.
errors.logoTooMany: Too many uploads in a short time — try again in 10 minutes.

catalog.noneParties: No contacts yet. Add the first one or save it when issuing a document.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.copyNote: The change applies to future documents — issued ones keep their data from the moment of issue.
catalog.seriesHelp: Each series is a continuous range of ten-digit numbers. A company's series never overlap; the issued part of a series cannot be cut.
catalog.startLockedHint: The series already has issued documents — its start cannot move and its end cannot drop below the last issued number.
catalog.newSeriesHint: The main series usually covers the whole range: first lower its end, then create the new one in the freed part.

errors.invalidEik: The EIK is invalid — 9 or 13 digits with a correct check digit.
errors.vatMismatch: A Bulgarian VAT number is BG + the same contact's EIK.
errors.invalidCountry: The country is a two-letter code (BG, DE, IT…).
errors.invalidPrice: The price is a number with up to 6 decimals.
errors.invalidRate: The rate is a number (e.g. 20 or 9).
errors.rateCategory: Category S has a rate above 0; the other categories have rate 0.
errors.invalidRange: The start is after the end.
errors.nameTaken: A series with this name exists.
errors.overlap: The range overlaps another series of the company.
errors.startLocked: The start of a series with issued documents cannot move.
errors.issuedBelow: The end cannot drop below the last issued number.
errors.inUse: A series with issued documents cannot be deleted.
errors.isDefault: The default series cannot be deleted — choose another one first.

catalog.saveBuyer: Save the recipient as a contact

members.title: Members
members.inviteHelp: The invitation is an email link valid for 7 days. The role is below yours; the owner is not invited — ownership comes by transfer.

err.invalid: Check the email and the role.
err.forbiddenRole: You cannot give or change this role.
err.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of the company.
err.rateLimited: Too many invitations today — try tomorrow.
err.self: You cannot change your own role.

annul.button: Annul and issue a new one
annul.title: Annulment under Art. 116 of the VAT Act
annul.lead: You are annulling document no. {number} of {date}. The document you are issuing now replaces it — both happen in one step. The annulled number stays taken.
annul.hint: Only for an incorrectly drawn up document. A discount, return or cancelled supply is corrected with a credit or debit note (Art. 115 of the VAT Act).

reasons.vatMissing: VAT not charged when it should have been (para. 2)
reasons.vatCharged: VAT charged when it should not have been (para. 3)

export.myDataHelp: Download your personal data in a machine-readable format (JSON): profile, memberships, accepted documents, sessions and your actions in the audit log (Art. 15 and 20 GDPR).
export.closeHelp: The account is closed at once: sessions end, your name and email are erased. Companies' documents stay with them — the law obliges the company to keep them. If you are an owner, download the company export first.
export.closeConfirm: I understand that closing cannot be undone.

err.closeConfirm: Confirm the closing with the checkbox.
err.master: A master account is not closed from here.
err.transferFirst: You are the only owner of a company with other members — remove them first or write to us to transfer ownership.

plan.title: Plan
plan.closed: Plan orders are not open yet. Write to us if you want a paid plan now.
plan.nothing: No plan to pay for here. For “Custom” — write to us.
plan.clients: Client companies with an active mandate: {count}
plan.cardHelp: You pay on Revolut’s secure page. The plan starts when Revolut confirms the payment — usually within a minute.
plan.transferHelp: You get a pro forma with the IBAN and reference. The plan starts once the transfer arrives and we confirm it (within 1 business day).
plan.paid: Paid on {date}. The plan is active; the invoice is in the company inbox and by email.
plan.processing: The payment is being processed — this page refreshes itself. The plan starts as soon as Revolut confirms the payment.
plan.transferNote: Use the reference exactly — it links the transfer to the order. The invoice is dated with the payment date.
plan.cardNote: Revolut’s secure page opens. Card details never pass through us.
plan.creditLong: Credit for the unused paid period
plan.creditHelp: The unused part of your current paid plan is deducted from the price — in proportion to the days left, excl. VAT. The new plan starts on the day of payment.
plan.downgradeHelp: A cheaper plan whose price is fully covered by the unused time can be ordered after the paid period ends ({date}).

err.invalid: Choose a plan, a period and a payment method.
err.method: This payment method is not available.
err.audience: The plan is not for this kind of company.
err.free: There is nothing to pay on this plan.
err.noPrice: This plan is priced by agreement — write to us.
err.noSupplier: Plan orders are not open yet.
err.revolut: The payment page did not open. Try again shortly.
err.expired: The payment page has expired (24 hours). Place a new order from the page
err.downgrade: The unused time covers the whole new period — order this plan after the paid period ends.
err.creditStale: This order deducts a plan that is no longer active. Please place a new order.

recurring.title: Recurring
recurring.fromDocument: The template is taken from invoice No. {number}: its buyer, lines, notes and payment.
recurring.how: A recurring invoice is made from an issued invoice — the “Repeat” button on the document. Each period a new invoice is issued with the next number of the series, the issue date and a due date.
recurring.needsPlan: This feature is in the paid plans.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.nextHint: The day of month is kept (31st → last day of a shorter month).
recurring.endHint: Nothing is issued after this date.
recurring.sendToHint: PDF and XML on every issue. If the buyer is on Fakturist, the document also reaches their inbox.
recurring.periodHint: In lines and notes “{period}” becomes the period: “November 2026”, “Q4 2026”, “2026”.

err.invalid: Check the fields: the date cannot be in the past, the end is after the next issue.
err.feature: This feature is in the paid plans.
err.notInvoice: Only an issued invoice can be repeated.
err.state: The action is not possible in this state.
err.frequencyLocked: The frequency cannot change after the first issue (it would bill the same period twice). End this one and create a new one.
err.limit: The limit of 100 open recurring invoices is reached.

errors.rejected: the last issue failed the checks
errors.access: the creator can no longer issue
errors.feature: the plan no longer includes the feature

recurring.remindersHelp: 3 and 10 days after the due date the buyer receives an email with the invoice PDF and the amount outstanding — at the email on the document. Replies go to you. Paid invoices (marked on the document or from bank matching) get no reminder.

result.invalid: Check the amount and the date.
result.amount: The amount exceeds the outstanding balance or is zero.
result.date: The date cannot be in the future or before the document.
result.notPayable: No payment is recorded on this document.
result.source: A matched payment is removed from bank matching.

api.title: API keys
api.intro: A key connects your software (web shop, warehouse, CRM) to Fakturist: it reads documents, downloads PDF and XML, and issues. The key acts on behalf of the person who created it, with their rights at the time.
api.needsPlan: The API is in the Business plan and above.
api.once: Copy it now — it is shown only once. We keep only its fingerprint; if lost, revoke it and create a new one.
api.name: Name
api.limit: Up to {max} active keys per company.
api.docsIntro: Base path: /api/v1. The key goes in the Authorization header. Responses are JSON.

docs.amounts: Amounts are text with a dot (“100.00”), dates are YYYY-MM-DD. The number and the supplier come from Fakturist, not from the request.
docs.idempotency: Idempotency-Key when issuing: a repeated request with the same key returns the same document instead of issuing a second one.
docs.errors: Errors: 400 invalid request, 401 key, 403 rights or plan, 422 the document fails the checks (with the rule codes), 429 too many requests.
docs.limits: Limit: 120 requests per minute per key, of which up to 30 issues.

err.invalid: Enter a name and at least one right.
err.feature: The API is in the Business plan and above.
err.limit: The limit of active keys is reached — revoke an old key.

bank.title: Bank
bank.intro: Upload a bank statement — incoming payments are linked to invoices by the number in the reference and the amount. You confirm; a confirmed line becomes a payment on the invoice.
bank.needsPlan: Bank matching is in the Business plan and above.
bank.fileHint: camt.053 (XML) or CSV, up to 2 MB. Only incoming payments are kept.

reasons.number: by the number in the reference

ok.svarzhi: The payment is recorded on the invoice.
ok.deleted: The statement is deleted. Lines linked to invoices remain without the payer’s name, account and reference, so the same payment is never imported twice. Payments on the invoices remain.

err.feature: Bank matching is in the Business plan and above.
err.xml: The XML file is not valid.
err.notCamt: The XML file is not a camt.053 statement.
err.csvHeader: We cannot find the date and amount columns in the CSV file.
err.encoding: The file encoding is not recognised (UTF-8 or windows-1251).
err.tooMany: Too many lines in one statement.
err.currency: The payment and the invoice are in different currencies.
err.paymentAmount: The amount exceeds the invoice balance.
err.paymentNotPayable: No payment is recorded on this document.
err.paymentSource: The payment is not from bank matching.

bank.skipped: Lines with an unreadable amount: {count} — check them in your bank.
bank.retention: We keep only incoming payments and only for matching: 90 days after a line is linked or skipped, the payer’s name, account and reference are erased; unmatched lines are deleted after 12 months. You and your bank keep the statements under the Accountancy Act.

incoming.title: Incoming
incoming.intro: The register of received invoices: those delivered to your inbox come in automatically; an e-invoice from other software (UBL 2.1 or CII) is uploaded here and checked against EN 16931 and the Bulgarian VAT Act.
incoming.fileHint: UBL 2.1 or CII, up to 2 MB.
incoming.clean: The document passes the EN 16931 and VAT Act checks.
incoming.checkHint: The errors are the issuer’s — the document is stored as received. If in doubt, ask the supplier for a corrected document.

ok.uploaded: The invoice is in the register and passes the checks.
ok.uploadedIssues: The invoice is in the register but has issues — see the check.

err.xml: The file is not valid XML.
err.dtd: The file contains a DTD or entities — refused (protection).
err.notInvoice: The file is not a UBL 2.1 or CII invoice.
err.duplicate: This file is already in the register.
err.date: Enter the payment date (not in the future).

proforma.title: Pro forma invoices
proforma.how: A pro forma invoice is a request for payment: it is not a tax document under the VAT Act and takes no number from the invoice series. When the customer pays (or on delivery), “Issue invoice” turns it into an invoice with a new number.
proforma.notTax: A pro forma invoice is not a tax document — the invoice is issued upon payment or delivery.
proforma.sendHint: The email carries a PDF copy; replies go to the company email. It counts towards the limit of 200 emails per day to addresses outside Fakturist.
proforma.typeHint: A “pro forma invoice” is not a tax document and takes no number from the series.
proforma.invoiceFrom: Invoice from pro forma {number}: the data comes from the pro forma, the dates are today. Check them before issuing.

ok.created: The pro forma invoice has been created.
ok.sent: The email is queued for sending.
ok.cancelled: The pro forma invoice has been cancelled.

err.notOpen: The pro forma invoice has already been invoiced or cancelled.
err.notFound: The pro forma invoice was not found.
err.mailLimit: The limit of 200 emails per day to addresses outside Fakturist has been reached. Try tomorrow.
err.type: A pro forma invoice becomes an invoice or a prepayment invoice.
